spheres_to_silhouette — DRIVE granular op

• 数据种类:matrix × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → image2d

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.spheres_to_silhouette(pos, radius: 'float', pitch: 'float', extent: 'float', height: 'float', supersample: 'int' = 4) -> 'np.ndarray'(要直接调用实现,import granular; granular.spheres_to_silhouette(pos, radius: 'float', pitch: 'float', extent: 'float', height: 'float', supersample: 'int' = 4) -> 'np.ndarray';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("spheres_to_silhouette"))

用法

由球心序列生成从侧面(y 方向)看的正交投影覆盖率图像(圆盘之并，抗锯齿)。第 0 行在最上方。
